name: Dataproc (now Managed Service for Apache Spark)
sku: Dataproc clusters, documented as Managed Service for Apache Spark on clusters. The record ID keeps the old name because IDs are immutable. Serverless for Apache Spark is a separate deployment and is not scored.

transform.code-transform.note: A managed platform for open-source data tools for batch processing, querying, streaming and machine learning: Spark, Hadoop, Hive, Pig, Flink and Presto, with no new APIs to learn.

transform.stream-processing.note: Streaming is among its listed workloads, and Flink runs on the clusters. Continuous event processing is a secondary use next to batch.

bands.note: Clusters are created, scaled and shut down in 90 seconds or less on average, with no administrator overhead. Cluster shape and applications are still chosen by the customer.
Built-in connectivity with Cloud Logging and Cloud Monitoring.

presentation.tagline: Managed Spark and Hadoop clusters, quick to create and shut down.
